Daily Devotional

July 17

4 Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance? (Romans 2:4 KJV)

Religious legalists of the Jews, as well as those of today, cannot agree with the fact that the goodness of God leads people to repentance. They can only relate to using fear to motivate people to be saved, but they don’t realize that teaching fear causes torment (1 John 4:18). Teaching the Law of Works and that you have to do all the works to be saved or right with God, causes the entire burden of salvation and being a Christian onto the backs of us. It causes people to feel unworthy and condemned, as they never feel they can do enough to be right with God. Yet there should be no feelings of condemnation to those that are saved, and walking after the Spirit (Romans 8:1).

Jesus brought us the Grace and forgiveness of God, so that we don’t have to keep the Law brought by Moses, to be right with God. All we have to do is believe in Jesus and keep His commandments of, Love God above everything, and Love your neighbor as yourself (Matthew 22:37-39). Anyone that will do those two things will keep the whole law (Matthew 22:40), and under this New Covenant, our sins are all forgiven and we are the very righteousness of Jesus in our spirits (Romans 3:22). Boy that is so much better then trying to keep the law. Instead of having to do, we just have to love. Of course if you truly love God, you should want to serve Him, but aren’t damned if you don’t (1 Peter 1:15). Praise God for His gift of Jesus.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
